dz: 博斯沃斯战地(Battle of Bosworth Field)发生;英格兰国王理查三世在战斗中被击毙,标志着统治的普兰特涅王朝的终结和亨利七世统治下的都铎人的开始.
de: The Battle of Bosworth Field occurs; King Richard III of England's death in battle marks the end of the reigning Plantagenet dynasty and the beginning of the Tudors under Henry VII.
